options.B: recording them in the cash book by debiting Bank Charges Account
options.C: ignoring them permanently
options.D: adding them to the capital account

e: The correct answer is recording them in the cash book by debiting Bank Charges Account. This is a concept-clarity question. The right option follows directly from the definition; the wrong ones look plausible only with an approximate recall. Tighten the definition in your revision notes. Remember: Watch the timeline or sequence in such questions; many errors come from mixing up the order. Make a one-line note of this concept for revision; it recurs in several papers.
